Try a shorter keyword, another category, or a different source.
Enable auto capture and choose your apps. Readable text from the pages you view will appear here automatically.
The captured text is preserved. Model classification never rewrites it. You can edit the memory or delete it from the menu.
This memory has no edits. Classification never changes the original text. Up to five previous versions are retained.
This removes the text, edit history, and search results, and takes out what the board and user card drew from it; they are reorganized shortly. The same page will not be captured again for 30 days.
Edits update only this memory and retain the previous version.
A next step, when it helps
Suggestions come from saved memories. Accept one to let the Agent organize it in a read-only task.
When a memory has a useful next step, it will appear here. You can explore your saved memories in the meantime.
Suggestions are paused. Your memories remain available. Auto capture and model analysis have separate controls.
The Agent is still working. Check back shortly.

Saved and newly queued text from your selected apps will be batched and sent to the chosen model through on-device Magpie. Turning analysis off keeps the local records and queue; turning it back on resumes analysis. Requests already sent may not be cancellable, but late results will be ignored.

Readable text from selected apps will be saved on this device automatically. Text is sent through Magpie only if you separately enable model analysis. You can pause capture, exclude apps, or delete memories at any time. Passwords, editable input, and protected windows are excluded.
Save readable text after a page settles. Screenshots and videos are not stored.
Uses the system text model through Taku AI, or a selected Jev model. Pause independently of capture; resume to analyze queued memories in batches.
Not selected · Analysis must be enabled separately
Find relevant memories with their source, timestamp, and revision.
Offer a useful next step. No task is created until you accept.
Queue, batch timing, and service status
Text stored locally · Credentials managed by Magpie

Memories merge for about 20 seconds, with up to 5 per batch. Limits are one batch per 15 seconds and 60 per hour.

Rate-limited or failed records stay queued for retry. Android background scheduling may add delays. Pausing capture does not stop the queue; model analysis has its own switch.

Batch attempts count local reservations, not upstream billable requests.
No models found. Configure Magpie in the Assistant first.
Choosing a model does not send requests. Queued text is sent only after you separately enable model analysis. Unsent drafts and account credentials are excluded.
%1$d queued · %2$d processing\n%3$d batch attempts · Last batch: %4$d records
Saved. I can organize the key points and next steps.
Suggestions unavailable. Check the system surface component.
Service unavailable; queue retained for retry

After you enable capture and choose apps, readable page text is saved automatically when the page settles. Locked screens, protected windows, passwords, and editable input are excluded. Model analysis uses on-device Magpie. You can pause capture or delete memories at any time.
Retention must be forever (0) or 1 to 30 days
No response from the memory service

Review the timing and preparation; keep missing details marked as unknown.
Outline the saved route and timing, and flag what still needs checking.

At 11 PM, new content is organized into the board and user card. If the phone is off or offline then, it catches up later. Runs through the assistant with your model account.
When helping you, the assistant first checks what is in progress on the board.
When helping you, the assistant sees only the parts of the user card related to the task.
Used while organizing to tell which messages are yours.
Waiting to reorganize after a deletion or correction
Every version of the board and user card is deleted, then rebuilt from the remaining memories. More memories use more model quota.
Clear board and user card, then reorganize
Organized from recent content on this phone · %1$s. Items you delete are not written back by later organizing.
Later organizing will not write it back. Your memories are not affected.
With nightly organizing on, what you are working on shows up here.
About you and the people who matter to you · %1$s. The assistant only sees the parts related to each task. Items you delete are not written back.
With nightly organizing on, your habits and the people who matter to you show up here.

Follow the Taku AI memory scene route
Follow Taku AI (%1$s · needs a Magpie connection)
Needs a Magpie connection and a memory route group in Taku AI
A bedtime brief after nightly organizing, and a short note when a new notification touches something remembered. Uses your model account through Taku AI.

Taku Memory will send your user card at night, and a new notification with the few remembered lines it touches, to the organizing model through Taku AI, then show a notification when there is something worth saying. At most 8 message notes a day. You can turn this off at any time.
Sent to Agent (read-only). The result appears in the Agent.
This reminder was already sent to the Agent.

Reminders also appear as cards on the Taku home feed. Memory reads back what you do with them (remove, pin, hand to Taku) and takes them down when they expire or you remove them. For now other apps on this phone can read home feed cards.
Let the home feed\'s AI design cards

Sends the content and buttons to the Taku home as a description and lets its AI lay out the card. Each card takes one more model call and can take a minute or two; if its card changes the buttons or content, or none can be made, the fixed layout is used.

Make a Taku home feed card: a bedtime brief. It lists what the user needs to handle before tomorrow, which Taku Memory gathered from the user's own messages and records.
%1$s.
List these %2$d items in order, each exactly as written; do not reword, merge, split, drop or add any:
%3$s
Each item is one text without numbering, at most two lines. With more than 3 items, page them: Pager props {"index":{"$bindState":"/ui/page"}}, each page a Column of at most 3 items; below the Pager put Dots with props {"count":pages,"index":{"$state":"/ui/page"}}; ui.state is {"ui":{"page":0}}.

Make a Taku home feed card: %1$s sent a new message and Taku Memory recalled something related.
%2$s.
First quote the message in an Inset: a small line “%3$s” above the message, copied exactly:
%4$s
Then show what Taku wants to say in larger, prominent text, exactly as written; this is the point of the card:
%5$s
Below what Taku says, add one tag: “%1$s”.

Structure: the root is a Column whose children, top to bottom, are the header, the body and the button row; when paging, the header, the Pager, the Dots and the button row. Every element must hang in this tree.
Structure: the root is a Column whose children, top to bottom, are the header, the quote, what Taku says, the tag (if any) and the button row. Every element must hang in this tree.

%1$s
The button row holds only the buttons in actions, in their JSON order: the last is the primary button and the others are secondary. Give each button element, next to type, props and children, an on field: {"press":{"action":"dispatch","params":{"actionId":"its key in actions"}}}.
Use this JSON object as actions exactly, without changing a character; mind the closing brackets:
%2$s
There are no images or avatars, so use no component that needs one (such as MessageQuote). Write summary exactly as: %3$s. Use only what is given here and add nothing else. Output one complete JSON object in the order summary, actions, ui; use short English element ids and leave out props you do not need.

My bedtime brief listed the items below. Order what tomorrow needs by importance; for each, give the time, what to prepare and what to confirm first. Draft any replies for me to see; do not send anything.
%1$s wrote: “%2$s”\nTaku Memory noted: %3$s\nUse my memory to draft a reply. Show it to me first; do not send it.
%1$s: “%2$s”\nTaku Memory noted: %3$s\nUse my memory to work out what I should do next. Draft any reply for me to see; do not send anything.
